membershipRules.fbsScope: ML scoring later requires verified FBS–FBS; non-FBS excluded here

causalStateRecipe.rule: Pre-kickoff ratings only: seed 2024 FBS–FBS → update chronologically through TUNING + any FINAL_EVAL games with kickoff < target kickoff. Never use target game sealedOutcome in predict. Never use FINAL_EVAL outcomes for α/param selection (α frozen at 1.15).
causalStateRecipe.finalEvalWalk: included FINAL_EVAL members sorted by kickoff; update after predict using sealedOutcome only for state carry-forward — not for selection
causalStateRecipe.selectionIsolation: outcomeSealed=true on FINAL_EVAL rows; harness allowFinalEvalScoring=false until authorized
